Name: Peaceful Perfection - A Pacifist Stardew Mod
Author: FaustOfTheVoid
Description:
This mod adds alternative ways to complete parts of the game that would usually require killing and so allows for a completely pacifist run that does not rely on Joja. It does not, by itself, remove the need to level up combat however. You will have to do that with skill books. There is an optional feature to make this much easier and remove the rng element from it, though.

If at any point you do end up killing a monster, anything you already unlocked should stay as it is, but the rest of the game will essentially "return to normal" from there and you won't be able to unlock any other alternative/pacifist options.

[size=6][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
- Smapi 4.5.1 or newer
- Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer

[b][size=6]Core Features:[/size]
[/b][size=5]
Replaces Monster Eradication Goals[/size]

Once you reach certain non-lethal goals, you will receive a letter with an Eradication Goal reward and the corresponding Eradication Goal will be removed from the game. The day after that, the Perfection Tracker should also update. [b]These new goals will only activate, if you have not killed any monsters up to the point of reaching them[/b]. The new goals are:

[list]
[*][b]Slimes[/b]: Build at least one Slime Hutch while having 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Void Sprites[/b]: Have at least 5 Hearts with Krobus and 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Pepper Rex[/b]: Ship at least one Dino Mayonnaise while having 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Bats[/b]: Reach Mines Floor 30 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Cave Insects[/b]: Reach Mines Floor 40 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Skeletons[/b]: Reach Mines Floor 60 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Dust Sprites[/b]: Reach Mines Floor 80 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Duggies[/b]: Reach Mines Floor 100 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Rock Crabs[/b]: Reach Mines Floor 120 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Serpents[/b]: Reach Skull Cavern Floor 25 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Mummies[/b]: Reach Skull Cavern Floor 100 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Magma Sprites[/b]: Reach the Forge with 0 kill[/*]
[/list][b]If the Monster Slayer Hero stat doesn't update to Yes after completing all Goals, try quitting out of your save and reloading it. That seems to fix it.[/b]

[size=5]Adds Alternative Way To Access The Adventurer's Guild[/size]

If you make it to [b]Mines Floor 40 without killing anything[/b], you will receive a letter from Marlon which also includes the Iridium Band Crafting Recipe. The [b]morning after reading this letter[/b], an alternatively worded version of the updated "Initiation" Quest will appear in your Journal, allowing you to enter/join the Adventurer's Guild.


[size=5]Changes Clints Special Order ("Cave Patrol")[/size]

If you [b]read the above letter from Marlon after reaching Floor 40 with 0 kills[/b], Clints Special Order will change. Instead of requiring you to kill a certain amount of monsters, it will now require you to [b]get 100 iron ore and deliver them to Clint[/b].

[size=5]Adds Alternative Ways To Get The Recipes For Monster Musk And Mini Obelisk[/size]

Once you reach a certain amount of Hearts with the Wizard while also not having killed any monsters, he will send you the recipes in the mail, thus bypassing the Special Orders.

[list]
[*][b]Monster Musk[/b]: 6 Hearts with the Wizard and 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Mini Obelisk[/b]: 10 Hearts with the Wizard and 0 kills[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Adds "Mapping Cave Systems" To The Adventurer's Guild Shop[/size]

Mapping Cave Systems is the Book usually found in Marlons room, which requires 1000 kills total to enter. To bypass this, Marlon will now sell one copy for 4000g[b] every Friday after you read the letter for reaching the Forge with 0 kills[/b].

[size=5]Adds A Golden Walnut To The Island Trader[/size]

To bypass the Walnut usually gained from killing a Tiger Slime, the Island Trader will trade you one Golden Walnut for 5 Ancient Fruit [b]every Monday [/b][b]after you read the letter for reaching the Forge with 0 kills[/b]

[size=5]Adds Bug Meat And Dwarf Scroll III To Krobus Shop  [/size]

 Krobus now sells unlimited Bug Meat for 50g each and unlimited Dwarf Scroll IIIs for 200g each. This allows you to get the Translation Guide, the Museum Collection and the "Juicy Bugs Wanted" Special Order without killing monsters. For convenience sake, the supply of Slime on Mondays and Bat Wings on Sundays have also been changed to be infinite, meaning you can buy as many as you like instead of just 10/50 each week.

[size=5]Adds A New Weapon To Pierre's Shop[/size]

Pierre now sells a "Pen" for 200g, which does 0 damage but has a lot of knockback. This is meant to help keep monsters, especially those flying ones, away from you without risking accidentally killing them.

[size=6][b]Optional Features
[/b][/size]
These features are disabled by default. You can turn them on by going into the mods config file and changing "false" to "true" or, if you have the Generic Mod Config Menu, you can use that and just check the relevant boxes instead. I would recommend the latter.

[size=5]Removes The Need To Kill Fish ("PacifistFish")[/size]

Be aware that I am working under the assumption that donating Fish doesn't kill them. What this does:
[size=4]
Changes Cooking Recipes to be Vegetarian[/size]

look off. The Changes are:

[list]

[size=4]Removes Smoked Fish From The Shipping Collection[/size]

This means shipping Smoked Fish will no longer be required for Perfection.

[size=4]Adds Smoked Fish to Willy's Shop[/size]

This is meant to be a workaround for the Raccoon Requests, since you can't change them with Content Patcher and I don't know C#. The fish are only sold on specific days and in the relevant seasons to avoid cluttering the menu. The schedule is:

[list]

[*][b]Smoked Bullhead[/b]: Tuesdays, All Seasons[/*]
[*][b]Smoked Chub[/b]: Wednesdays, All Seasons[/*]
[*][b]Smoked Ghostfish[/b]: Thursdays, All Seasons[/*]

[*][b]Smoked Tilapia[/b]: Sundays, Summer and Fall[/*]

[*][b]Smoked Tuna[/b]: Mondays, Summer and Winter[/*]
[*][b]Smoked Rainbow Trout:[/b] Tuesdays, Summer[/*]
[*][b]Smoked Salmon: [/b]Wednesday, Fall[/*]

Adds Alternative Ways To Get The Combat Levelling And Mastery Recipes ("PacifistCrafting")[/size]

This is meant for players who want to avoid levelling up Combat at all. Since it is, to the best of my knowledge, not possible to change the levelling requirements for Perfection or Mastery using only Content Patcher, [b]you will not be able to reach Perfection or access the Mastery Cave without leveling up combat.[/b] To circumvent this, you can use the mods "[b]Relaxed Mastery[/b]" by NCarigon (which lets you enter the Mastery Cave and unlock the other Masteries without levelling Combat) and "[b]Perfection Tweaker[/b]" by shekurika (which lets you change the requirements for Perfection). Both of them are linked in the Requirements section.

If this is enabled, you will receive letters with the relevant Crafting or Cooking Recipe or unlock them in the Adventurer's Guild Shop when you reach certain goals without killing monsters. Most of them overlap with the alternative Monster Eradication Goals. They are:

[list]
[*][b]Sturdy Ring & Bug Steak:[/b] Sold in Adventurer's Guild Shop after reading the letter for reaching Mines Floor 40[/*]
[*][b]Slime Eggpress:[/b] Sold in Adventurer's Guild Shop after reading the letter for Building a Slime Hutch[/*]
[*][b]Explosive Ammo & Squid Ink Ravioli:[/b] Sold in Adventurer's Guild Shop after reading the letter for reaching Mines Floor 120[/*]
[*][b]Anvil & Mini-Forge:[/b] Sold in Adventurer's Guild Shop after reading the letter for reaching the Forge[/*]
[*][b]Life Elixir[/b]: Sent to you by Mail after reaching Mines Floor 20 with 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Roots Platter[/b]: Sent to you by Mail after reaching 5 Hearts with Penny while having 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Oil of Garlic[/b]: Sent to you by Mail after reaching 5 Hearts with Dwarf while having 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Ring of Yoba[/b]: Sent to you by Mail after reaching 8 Hearts with Krobus while having 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Slime Incubator[/b]: Sent to you by Mail after building at least 1 Slime Hutch while having 0 kills[/*]
[*][b]Iridium Band:[/b] Sent with the Guild Entry Letter at reaching Mines Floor 40 with 0 kills[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Makes The Monster Compendium And [/size][size=5]Combat Quarterly More Easily Available ("ConvenientBooks")[/size]

[b]You have to level up Combat to reach Mastery and Perfection.[/b] Skill Books are the only way to do this without Combat/Slaying Monsters, so this adds a more consistent and reliable way to get Combat Quarterly by allowing you to buy it from the Adventurer's Guild Shop in bulk. It also adds the Monster Compendium to the same shop so you can avoid having to wait for year 3 and rng to get it from the bookseller. [b]They become available once you enter the Guild after having read Marlons letter for reaching Mines Floor 40.
[/b][size=5]
Makes Monsters More Or Less Invincible ("BombproofMonsters")[/size]

This gives all monsters 9999 health, to prevent you from accidentally killing them while mining. Since most of the changes in this mod are tied to you not having any monster kills at all, accidentally killing something would force you to reset the day or lose any pacifist options not unlocked yet. This is meant to prevent that.

[size=5]Halves Or Removes Damage Taken From Monsters ("WeakMonsters" and "PeacefulMonsters")[/size]

"WeakMonsters" will half the damage you take from monsters. The numbers are rounded down, so for example if a monster normally has an attack of 5 it will now have 2. "PeacefulMonsters" will set the attack of all monsters to 0, making them more or less harmless to you. Projectiles from Skeletons will still do damage however, as will Duggies popping up under you. Only enable one of these at a time.

[size=6][b]How To Install:[/b][/size]

1. Download the mod folder
2. Unzip it into the "Mods" folder (the file path will vary but should end in "Stardew Valley/Mods")
3. Run the Game

Make sure that smapi and Content Patcher are installed as well.


[size=6][b]Other Things:[/b][/size]
Some of the ideas in this mod were inspired by the mod "Optional Combat" by Mr Tea, which sadly doesn't really work properly with 1.6.

The Banner in the first image was made using kdaus "Stardew Scroll Generator".

If you would like some leeway for how many monsters you can kill before the mod "deactivates" you can edit that number by
[list=1]
[*]Opening the Content.json file for the mod[/*]
[*]Searching for "PLAYER_KILLED_MONSTERS"[/*]
[*]Changing the last 0 before the comma to whatever your preferred number of acceptable total monster kills is[/*]
[*]Repeating step 3 for each instance of "PLAYER_KILLED_MONSTERS" in the file
[/*]
[/list]I did test the mod, but this is the first mod I've ever made so there may be bugs. If you find any, please tell me.

I also want to thank the folks from the Stardew Valley Discord who helped me with fixing some issues I had while working on this.
